optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Service Operations Manager, Financial Reporting System

professionalSummary.text: Has experience running month-end close rehearsals in pre-production for a financial reporting system replacement programme over 14 months, including maintaining runbooks and dashboards, coordinating changes, and drafting support procedures.
professionalSummary.witness: Responsibilities included close rehearsals, runbook and dashboard maintenance, change coordination and rota drafting for the reporting system replacement programme over about fourteen months.

experienceHighlights.text: Executed month-end close rehearsals in pre-production environment for five cycles, using a masked ledger copy and logging deviations for the programme team.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the month-end close rehearsals for the new reporting system in the pre-production environment for five cycles, executing the close runbook end to end against a masked copy of the ledger and logging every deviation for the programme team.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained the close runbook and service dashboard prototype, updating after each rehearsal cycle with timings and open defects.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the close runbook and the service dashboard prototype for the reporting system, updating both after each rehearsal cycle with the timings and the open defects.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated pre-production changes with finance and IT during the programme change window, while the incumbent supplier operated the live service.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated pre-production changes with finance and IT in the programme change window; the live service was still operated by the incumbent supplier, whose service manager handled production incidents during the parallel period.

experienceHighlights.text: Drafted the production support rota and close-window escalation procedure for adoption at cut-over, reviewed by head of finance systems.
experienceHighlights.witness: Drafted the production support rota and the close-window escalation procedure that the programme planned to adopt at cut-over, reviewed by the head of finance systems.
